decisions.title: Linear Retry with Static Backoff
decisions.summary: Legacy linear retry loop with static 1000ms delay between attempts for all failed billing HTTP requests.

decisions.title: Exponential Backoff with Full Jitter
decisions.summary: Mandates decorrelated exponential backoff with full jitter to eliminate retry storm stampedes against payment processor.

decisions.title: 24-Hour Session Lifetime in Auth
decisions.summary: Initial monolithic JWT session design granting 24-hour token validity without revocation mechanism.

decisions.title: Stateless RS256 JWT Authentication
decisions.summary: Mandates RS256 asymmetric signatures and strictly enforced 15-minute access token rotation paired with refresh tokens.

decisions.title: Direct Database Writes for Event Sync
decisions.summary: Synchronous in-process database commits during node synchronization before partition recovery.

decisions.title: Sync Failure Quarantine Protocol
decisions.summary: Quarantines un-reconciled sync payloads in dead-letter queues to prevent node desynchronization during reconnection.

decisions.title: Aggressive 500ms Gateway Upstream Timeout
decisions.summary: Initial 500ms timeout for gateway reverse proxy connections, causing false positive HTTP 504 drops during load spikes.

decisions.title: Gateway Adaptive 5000ms Buffer Timeout
decisions.summary: Requires 5000ms SLA timeout buffer on upstream reverse proxy calls to absorb service latency fluctuations.

decisions.title: Optimistic Concurrency Control in Billing Ledger
decisions.summary: Requires optimistic locking with version checks for all ledger transactions to prevent double charges.

decisions.title: Strict Inter-Service mTLS Certificate Validation
decisions.summary: Enforces mutual TLS authentication with strict certificate validation across all microservice RPCs.

decisions.title: Sync Pipeline Gzip Event Payload Compression
decisions.summary: Mandates gzip compression on all sync event payloads exceeding 64KB to conserve cross-region bandwidth.

decisions.title: Single-Node In-Memory Token Bucket Rate Limiting
decisions.summary: In-memory rate limiter per gateway instance; failed to protect multi-instance clusters.

decisions.title: Gateway Distributed Leaky Bucket Rate Limiting
decisions.summary: Mandates cluster-wide Redis token bucket rate limiting on public API gateway endpoints.

reverts.summary: Revert Linear Backoff on Gateway Timeout (Incident #1042 Retry Storm)
Revert aggressive gateway timeout reduction causing false 504 errors
Revert optimistic lock bypass in payment processing transaction
Revert mTLS validation skip in internal inter-service RPC
Revert event payload compression removal in sync pipeline
Revert in-memory rate limiter cache in favor of distributed Redis limiter
